projects.title: Sales Performance & KPI Dashboard
projects.overview: An interactive executive business intelligence dashboard tracking regional revenue, monthly sales velocity, and product-line margins.
projects.problem: Executive stakeholders lacked visibility into underperforming regional markets and product-level profit margins across fragmented sales records.
projects.results: Automated monthly financial reviews, reducing reporting turnaround by 65% and pinpointing the top 3 product lines contributing 72% of total revenue.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Model
projects.overview: A predictive machine learning classification model designed to forecast subscription customer churn and identify key churn indicators.
projects.problem: The business suffered high customer churn without early warning indicators, preventing marketing from executing timely retention campaigns.
projects.results: Trained an ensemble classifier achieving 88% ROC-AUC accuracy, empowering the retention team to preserve an estimated 16% of at-risk revenue.

projects.title: Netflix Content Exploratory Analysis
projects.overview: In-depth exploratory data analysis (EDA) of Netflix's global catalog spanning 8,800+ titles, genre shifts, and regional production trends.
projects.problem: Content acquisition needed quantitative evidence to evaluate the platform's multi-year pivot toward international TV series versus domestic films.
projects.results: Identified a 42% surge in Asian & European productions since 2019 and delivered dynamic visual reports on ratings and runtime distributions.

projects.title: SQL Business Intelligence Queries
projects.overview: Production-ready suite of complex SQL analytics queries evaluating customer lifetime value (CLV), purchase cohorts, and inventory turnover.
projects.problem: Cross-functional teams suffered from slow, manual Excel reconciliations to calculate monthly active buyers and recurring order intervals.
projects.results: Replaced manual data compilation with optimized subqueries and window functions, speeding up recurring query execution time by 50%.

projects.title: Workforce & HR Attrition Analytics
projects.overview: Comprehensive human capital dashboard analyzing department headcount distribution, attrition drivers, and employee compensation tiers.
projects.problem: HR leadership struggled to isolate specific causes behind talent departure and salary band disparities across departments.
projects.results: Isolated critical turnover triggers related to tenure and overtime, enabling data-informed retention interventions that decreased departure rates by 12%.

projects.title: Residential House Valuation Model
projects.overview: Supervised regression model predicting residential property sale prices from over 75 structural and neighborhood features.
projects.problem: Homebuyers and real estate analysts lacked reliable property valuation models, leading to inaccurate market listing assessments.
projects.results: Attained an R² score of 0.89 and lowered Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) through Lasso regularization and intelligent feature scaling.

projects.title: Global COVID-19 Statistical Tracker
projects.overview: Comprehensive statistical analysis and visualization of international infection trajectories, mortality rates, and multi-phase vaccine rollouts.
projects.problem: Raw public health datasets were massive and inconsistent, obscuring regional pandemic wave comparisons and recovery trends.
projects.results: Engineered rolling-average analytics and animated geographic charts across 190+ countries, clarifying vaccination milestone correlations.

projects.title: Automated ETL & Reporting Pipeline
projects.overview: Automated data ingestion and transformation tool that standardizes varied spreadsheet inputs, cleans errors, and produces executive reports.
projects.problem: Operations managers spent 8+ hours every week manually copying, scrubbing, and validating multi-source sales receipts.
projects.results: Reduced weekly manual reconciliation to under 30 seconds with 100% data integrity, generating structured Excel and summary logs.
